about: Operator: JSC Ufa International Airport; the airfield has two runways. The route network has 65 destinations, 22 of them international. In 2024 the airport handled 4,753,742 passengers.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Bashavtotrans buses No. 101, 110 and 110С. Timetable at bashauto.ru and by phone +7 (347) 297-97-92. Yandex Go taxis are ordered at desks in the baggage claim area and in the arrivals hall of the domestic terminal, payment in cash or by card.

terminals.title: Terminals
terminals.text: Terminal 1 serves domestic flights, terminal 2 international. Car park А2 is opposite terminal 1, А3 opposite terminal 2, 2 minutes to the terminals.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Agidel: terminal 1, Level 2, opposite gate No. 2; adults 6,000 ₽, children 2–12 years 3,000 ₽, over 3 hours 2,000 ₽ per hour. Iremel Lounge: for members of On Pass, Mir Pass, Every lounge, Grey wall pass, Persona Aero, RusPriority, others 3,000 ₽. Kurai: departure area of terminal 2, free for Aeroflot, Flydubai and Utair business class and programme cardholders, others 3,000 ₽. Children under 2 free.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Open round the clock, operator Pack & Fly, phone +7 (960) 803-80-67. One item no more than 203 cm (sum of three dimensions) and no heavier than 32 kg.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child room in terminal 1, Level 1, opposite the check-in counters, open round the clock. Children under 7 (with disabilities under 14) with one adult. Up to 12 hours before departure, up to 1 hour after arrival. A passport, birth certificate, tickets and a certificate from the domestic terminal health post are required.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Drop-off and pick-up zone А1: 15 minutes free, then 500 ₽ per hour, parking prohibited. Waiting car park С5 (10 minutes to the terminals): 3 hours free, then 150 ₽ per hour, a day 600 ₽. Car parks А2 and А3 at the terminals: first hour 300 ₽, then 100 ₽ per hour, a day 700 ₽.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free, with no time or data limits. Networks Airport.FreeWiFi.Ufanet and Airport.FreeWiFi.TTK. Login with a mobile number: enter the number, then call the number sent to you.
